{{Color box|{{party color|Arangkada San Joseño}}|border=darkgray}} [[Arangkada San Joseño]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''San Jose del Monte's at-large congressional district''' is the sole [[congressional district of the Philippines]] in the city of [[San Jose del Monte]] and one of seven in the province of [[Bulacan]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 2004.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 12, 2021}} San Jose del Monte first elected a single representative city-wide [[at-large]] for the [[13th Congress of the Philippines|13th Congress]] following the passage of Republic Act No. 9230 in 2003 which amended the 2000 San Jose del Monte City Charter (Republic Act No. 8797).{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=9230|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2003/12/18/republic-act-no-9230/ |title=An Act amending section 10(b) and section 58 of Republic Act No. 8797, otherwise known as “An Act converting the municipality of San Jose Del Monte, Bulacan into a component city to be known as the city of San Jose Del Monte” and providing funds therefor|date=December 18, 2003 |accessdate=August 21, 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://thecorpusjuris.com/legislative/republic-acts/ra-no-8797.php |title=Republic Act No. 8797 |date=15 July 2000 |publisher=The Corpus Juris |accessdate=February 12, 2020}} Before 2004, the city was represented in the nation's lower house as part of [[Bulacan's 4th congressional district|Bulacan's 4th]], [[Bulacan's 2nd congressional district|Bulacan's 2nd]], Bulacan's at-large and [[Region III's at-large parliamentary district|Region III's at-large]] districts.{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 12, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Arthur Robes]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]] (Lakas) and [[Arangkada San Joseño]] (AR).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 12, 2021}}{{cite news|url=https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1858438/5-from-pdp-laban-among-32-turncoats-to-marcos-party|title=5 from PDP-Laban among 32 turncoats to Marcos party|publisher=Philippine Daily
